misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen record linking each forecast’s specification, issuance time, eligible evidence cutoff, and matured outcome could establish whether a forecast was evaluable and how its outcome compared with its stated target. The supplied evidence does not show that this would have changed a decision or prevented a loss.
misses.decision_relevance: The settlement records provide point-in-time prices, but omit forecast contents, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs. The registry identifies this as an auditability gap; no decision failure is demonstrated.
misses.miss_description: DATA_GAP_ONLY: later target-time prices are recorded, but the corresponding frozen forecast specifications and timing provenance are unavailable, so the outcomes cannot be compared with what was stated beforehand.
misses.missing_history_problem: Without immutable forecast specifications, issuance and cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes, it is not possible to assess forecast alignment or determine whether any forecast was missed.
misses.outcome_reference: Settlement evidence records confirmed target-time mark prices, including BTC-USDT-SWAP at 79,635.7 (EXP-FC-f9b7fcc9fbc3e09be1f5) and 78,393.3 (EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36). These are point outcomes, not portfolio results.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
